articles.title: Politicians, private jets and power - the life of a Fifa president
articles.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino appears to be trying to return to business as usual after the failed World Cup private investment plan - but it may not be that easy.

articles.title: France set to take part in U20 Women's World Cup despite Uefa boycott threat
articles.summary: France say they are still planning to compete in the Under-20 Women's World Cup next month despite a threat from Uefa to boycott Fifa competitions.
